title: Audit relational data integrity
summary: Report duplicated member emails, teams without an owner, and orphaned rows in a single query.
objectives: Translate integrity rules into explicit audit queries.
Detect duplicate values within a scope instead of across the whole table.
Find missing relationships without relying on enforced foreign keys.
Combine independent audit results into one deterministic result set.
constraints: Return exactly the columns issue, entity_id, and detail in that order.
Order rows by issue ascending, then entity_id ascending, then detail ascending.
Duplicate member emails are scoped to one team and compared case-insensitively.
A team owner that is NULL or blank counts as missing.
Report orphans even when the database does not enforce foreign keys.
Return no rows when the data is clean.

examples.explanation: Duplicate detection is per team and ignores letter case.
A blank owner is as missing as a NULL owner.

examples.explanation: Orphans are found with an anti-join, not with a constraint error.
